trials.title: Intranasal oxytocin augmentation of brief cognitive-behavioral conjoint therapy (bCBCT) for veterans with PTSD
trials.sponsor: VA San Diego Healthcare System (PI Leslie Morland)
trials.dates: Multi-year; completion previously reported as ~Sept 2028 (not re-verified today)
trials.why: The single most important trial for the couples-therapy thesis; veteran self-administers oxytocin before each weekly session

trials.title: Brief CBCT for PTSD with adjunctive intranasal oxytocin (predecessor study)
trials.status: Unknown from index; protocol v2 and SAP posted
trials.why: Earlier pilot of the same design; results would de-risk NCT06194851

trials.title: OxyPLEASURE: intranasal oxytocin on sexual well-being in AVP deficiency and healthy controls (crossover)
trials.why: First controlled sexual-wellbeing trial in a defined oxytocin-deficient population; readout likely 2027

trials.title: PHOENIX: plasma oxytocin / neurophysin-I response to oral estradiol valerate and ethinylestradiol in healthy controls and AVP deficiency
trials.why: Attempt to build a non-MDMA diagnostic stimulation test for oxytocin deficiency; direct catalyst for the testing cluster

trials.title: OxyMENO: circulating oxytocin (via neurophysin-I) in postmenopausal vs premenopausal women
trials.why: Newest oxytocin trial found; links menopause and oxytocin-deficiency storylines

trials.title: Identification of oxytocin deficiency in adults with pituitary disease (estrogen-progestin stimulation)
trials.why: Completed study whose publication could define a deficiency test

trials.title: Identification and clinical relevance of an oxytocin-deficient state (melatonin study)
trials.why: Part of the same deficiency-definition program

trials.title: Identification and clinical relevance of an oxytocin-deficient state (CRH study)
trials.why: Part of the same deficiency-definition program

trials.title: Modulatory effects of oxytocin on emotional processing and its acting routes
trials.sponsor: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
trials.dates: Start 24 Jan 2026; primary completion est. Apr 2026
trials.why: Mechanistic study of routes of action; feeds the nose-to-brain content cluster

trials.title: Intranasal oxytocin for benzodiazepine withdrawal (16 IU x3/day for 21 days)
trials.why: Completed and unreported; a publication would be a fresh news hook

trials.title: Intranasal oxytocin for dementia caregiver stress (12 IU vs 24 IU vs placebo for 21 days)
trials.why: Caregiver-stress angle is uncovered by consumer content

trials.title: Oxytocin as add-on to psychosocial treatment in schizophrenia-spectrum disorders
trials.why: Schizophrenia is the one psychiatric signal the 2026 meta-analysis flagged

trials.title: Intranasal oxytocin for chronic pain (24 IU vs 48 IU vs placebo)
trials.why: Pain is a sleeper indication with zero consumer coverage

trials.title: Oxytocin to treat PTSD
trials.sponsor: VA Office of Research and Development
trials.why: Completed VA PTSD monotherapy trial; publication would be newsworthy

trials.title: Intravenous oxytocin for post-operative pain after minimally invasive hysterectomy
trials.why: Shows oxytocin-for-pain is an active academic theme

trials.title: Intranasal oxytocin vs placebo in binge eating disorder (8 weeks)
trials.why: Weight and eating remain a high-curiosity supporting topic

trials.title: Phase 2 intranasal oxytocin vs placebo for hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome (N=50 age 5-17)
trials.why: Context for TNX-2900 and the carbetocin failure

trials.title: High-dose oxytocin nasal spray for treatment of tinnitus
trials.sponsor: NYU Langone Health (PI Lawrence C. Newman)
trials.status: TERMINATED (PI departure); completed 10 May 2022; results submitted Aug 2022
trials.why: The only registered oxytocin-tinnitus trial; Newman is the inventor on the tinnitus patent now behind Biohaven's BHV-1955
